text:
This is a rough visual estimate. The photo shows a meal before eating, so I can't see what will be left over and had to guess it.

Estimated servings:
- Fried rice with chicken and sauce: about 350 kcal
- Bok choy salad: about 60 kcal
- Mixed vegetables: about 60 kcal
- Cake slice: about 250 kcal
- Quiche or pastry with tomato sauce and pasta: about 400 kcal
- Braised beef with noodles and cabbage: about 450 kcal
- Orange juice: about 100 kcal
- Lemon drink: about 80 kcal

These add up to about 1750 kcal served. I assumed about 20% is left over, roughly 350 kcal, which leaves about 1400 kcal eaten.

For the macronutrients, I assumed about 20% of eaten energy from protein, 47% from carbohydrate and 33% from fat. That gives about 70 g protein, 165 g carbohydrate and 52 g fat.
